services.name: 1,200 Ft. Parasail Flight - Ka’anapali Beach
services.desc: Enjoy a 1,200 Ft. Parasail Flight! Each Flight is 8-17 minutes depending on weather conditions. The total duration of excursion is dependent on number of guest on board About 1,000 Ft! Our highest and longest flight option! The Captain will let out 1,000 Ft of line and off you go! 1-3 people can fly at the same time. Some restrictions apply depending on weight and wind conditions; ultimately it’s the Captain’s decision. The minimum combined weight is 130lbs and maximum combined weight about 450-550 lbs. Weight requirements change daily due to wind conditions and are subject to Ages 5+

services.name: Private Parasail Tour - Ka'anapali Beach
services.desc: Enjoy a private 1,200 Ft. Parasail Flight! Each Flight is 8-17 minutes depending on weather conditions. Total tour is 1 Hour About Bring up to 12 people and have the boat all to yourselves for the hour! This is the perfect option if you would like to have longer flight times and a more private experience. 1-3 people can fly at the same time. Some restrictions apply depending on weight and wind conditions; ultimately it’s the Captain’s decision. The minimum combined weight is 130lbs and maximum combined weight about 450-550 lbs. Weight requirements change daily due to wind conditions Ages 5+

includes: Harness fitting and dry takeoff and landing on the boat deck

blurb: Guests fly solo, tandem, or triple on a parasail with dry takeoff and landing from a boat. Flights last 8 to 14 minutes in the air, with the whole trip about an hour including shuttle from the beach. The operation runs May 16 to December 14, with USCG-certified captains and safety equipment.
extraNote: If wind or sea conditions are outside limits, reschedule or full refund · Final flight call is made by USCG-certified captain on the day · Donations are final and non-refundable. · Duration Each Flight is 8-17 minutes depending on weather conditions. · Customers will receive a refund, less online booking fees and a 20% cancellation fee, with a minimum of 72 hours’ notice prior to the scheduled departure. · In the event of an operator cancellation due to weather or other unforeseen circumstances, customers may choose to rebook for a future date or receive a full refund, including booking fees. · Any reservation that is rescheduled, modified, or changed at the discretion of the customer—regard

quotes.text: The crew was friendly, professional, and made us feel safe the entire time. The views of Kaʻanapali Beach were absolutely incredible.
We had an unforgettable time. The launch and landing were smooth, and the scenery was stunning.
